feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people
entry.summary: Flight data shows the jet dropped at least 9,000 feet over two minutes, then leveled off for several more minutes, before disappearing.

entry.title: The record-breaking, genre-melting, career-redefining evolution of Miranda Lambert
entry.summary: Lambert started out as a scrappy country singer with a me-against-the-world attitude. How did she end up making lush disco songs and writing one of the biggest pop hits of the year?

entry.title: Just short of its 200th birthday, a landmark natural history museum shuts down
entry.summary: Beloved for its dinosaurs, Philadelphia's storied Academy of Natural Sciences closed down this week, amid an intense fight by local residents, politicians and scientists to save it.

entry.title: All's fair in love and 'War' — a well-cast, classy-trashy divorce drama
entry.summary: HBO's War is intended to be an anthology series about two dueling London law firms. The first season stars Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a high-profile couple in the midst of a very nasty divorce.

entry.title: Theaster Gates bets on fine china
entry.summary: The famed Chicago-based artist's career is taking a new direction with the purchase of Pickard China, the sole remaining maker of fine china in the United States.

entry.title: The Supreme Court faces another term jam-packed with controversy
entry.summary: The Supreme Court term opens on Monday with big test cases on religion, guns and climate change. Plus, the emergency docket keeps popping.

entry.title: No one expected Leo to be pope — except everyone who knew him as 'Bob'
entry.summary: When the 2025 conclave began, no one expected an American pope. But by its end, Cardinal Robert Prevost had become Pope Leo. Here's a look behind the scenes.

entry.title: 4 ways to battle performance anxiety, according to a confidence coach
entry.summary: Worried about stumbling before a high-stakes event, like a race or a job interview? Psychologist Cindra Kamphoff offers creative strategies to overcome the jitters and build confidence in the moment.

entry.title: How the system failed us: Former foster youth tell their stories
entry.summary: Former foster youth with disabilities tell their stories — of how they got through foster care

entry.title: Brazil's big political rematch: What to know about the Brazilian election
entry.summary: Four years after President Lula narrowly defeated Jair Bolsonaro, Brazil is back at the ballot box. This time, Lula faces Bolsonaro's son, Flávio, in a high-stakes rematch.
